python3 - <<'PY'
import limited_client as robot
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
obs=robot.observe(camera=2)
Image.fromarray(obs['rgb']).save('/app/output/cam2.png')
im=obs['rgb'].astype(float); d=obs['depth_m']; K=obs['intrinsic']; T=obs['camera_to_world']
# apple has saturated red/orange and green pixels; select chromatic colors in drawer region
r,g,b=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
mask=((r>g*1.15)&(r>b*1.10)&(r>55)&(g>25)) | ((g>r*1.10)&(g>b*1.05)&(g>45)&(r>25))
# restrict to the visible drawer/fruit area from the overview
mask[:180,:]=False
ys,xs=np.where(mask & np.isfinite(d) & (d>0.1) & (d<3.0))
print('candidate count',len(xs))
if len(xs):
    # report spatial bins to distinguish fruit from other scene colors
    for y0,y1 in [(240,360),(180,240),(360,480)]:
        q=(ys>=y0)&(ys<y1)
        if q.any():
            x=xs[q]; y=ys[q]; z=np.median(d[y,x]); u=np.median(x); v=np.median(y)
            p=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],z,1.])
            w=T@p
            print('bin',y0,y1,'n',len(x),'uvz',u,v,z,'world',w[:3])
print('robot',obs['robot'])
print('status',robot.status())
PY

import numpy as np

Image.fromarray(obs['rgb']).save('/app/output/cam2fresh.png')
